## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `swift test`
- [ ] `swift build --configuration release`
- [ ] Manual testing completed when behavior or UI changed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when needed
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, seed phrases, personal paths, or build artifacts added

## Risk

Call out destructive behavior, filesystem edge cases, privacy implications, or
compatibility changes. Write `None` when there are no known risks.
